coverage_notes: Viewed every registered anchor on PDF pages 3-6 and 11, plus materials/compositions on pp.1-2. Table 4, Table 5, all registered Fig.1-3 markers, photo labels, and registered Fig.21/22 overlays were assessed. No full-paper outcome census is implied.
shared_qualifications: Table 5 scan, scratch and current-time results are distinct quantities/procedures. The supplied CRA rows represent scan and scratch results, not the current-time upper bounds or all other paper outcomes. C3: 10 mV/min / 60 = 0.166667 mV/s, compatible with CRA 0.167.

Table 3 compositions (PDF p.2) identify F460-F475. B-series has the additional 1 h at 1049 C then water quench (p.4); A-series lacks that final treatment. Table 5 run numbers are preserved in source observations, not treated as CRA identifiers.

CRA 430 is the 125-142 mV scan range for F464B runs 1123 and 1134; each observation is one endpoint/run. CRA 446 is shared by the two separately registered 98 mV F464B scratch runs. Shared assignments do not make the runs identical or provide independent CRA targets.

obs_085 source conflict: Table 5 gives F469B scratch 165 mV, matching CRA 451, but the registered Figure 7 label gives 265 mV. Both source readings are retained and this disagreement is explicitly flagged.

The registered Fig.2 filled-circle interpolated base-alloy observations are assessed and retained; they do not correspond to the actual substituted multicomponent alloys represented in CRA. Fig.21/22 overlays are not converted into new material identities merely from summed Cr+Mo coordinates.
Table 3 F464 nominal values include Fe 73.37 and Mn 0.09 wt.% while the corresponding CRA rows use 73.38 and 0.08. Those minor cell conflicts are preserved; Cr/Mo/Ni/Al/Nb identify the alloy.

The slabs were hot rolled at 1090C to 1/16 inch thickness. Oxide scale was subsequently removed by sand blasting before a final annealing treatment. Following preparation, each alloy was hot rolled to 0.1 inch sheet and water quenched. Hot rolling temperatures were restricted to a maximum of 982C and a minimum of 816C. The hot rolled sheet was electropolished in an aqueous 15wt% NaCl/ 30wt%H2SO4 electrolyte to remove surface scale and sheared into 1 inch wide strips running parallel to the hot rolling direction. The 1 inch wide hot rolled strips were subsequently cold rolled from 0.1 inch to a final thickness of 0.0625inch.
